name: script-compose
description: Handles explicit screenplay/story work on the filmmaking canvas. Triages screenplay (use verbatim), story/concept (iterate then rewrite), or neither (defer). Captures the final script note/title; on explicit command, splits into <=15s shot notes and extracts characters, variants, locations, and speaking/VO needs. Use for writing, adapting, rewriting, splitting, analyzing, or breaking down scripts/stories. Preserves dialogue verbatim and returns multi-stage planning to story-to-video-workflow before media generation. Does not split/analyze on file drop or without explicit intent.
